note: Measured on 2026-09-14 against gameplay-export pack v11 (/mnt/archive/datasets/melee/skirmish-gameplay/v11-snapshot-20260914/fox-bf, identical numbers to v10, a pure pack-version bump). Fixed since the prior baseline (150, action_state, on P4's own smash-entered Turn-to-Dash conversion): fn_800C9C2C (ftCo_Turn.c:160-171) is the only place tilt_x_age/dash_window gates anything -- it latches x8 when the window holds and never clears it once latched; ftCo_Turn_IASA's own final check right before ftCo_Dash_Enter (:128-135) rechecks only the stick-vs-threshold half of that expression, deliberately not the window. The prior fix's own smash_this_frame variable bundled the window into both the latch step and the final gate, so a stale window (P4 latches turn_smash at frame 149 with tilt_x_age 1, but the flip lands at frame 150 with tilt_x_age already at 2, the window boundary) still wrongly blocked an already-latched conversion. game::locomotion::update_actions's Action::Turn arm now splits the two: a windowless stick_past_threshold feeds the final gate, while the window still gates only the fresh-latch step. 297 frames now match (-123 through 173); the new first divergence is frame 174, field action_age on P1 (expected 1.0, actual 0.0), on the frame P1 enters Fox's own Down Special (Reflector/Shine) Start phase (Slippi action state 360, SpecialLwStart). Not the already-fixed extra-entry-advance class alone: state_age holds at a constant 1.0 for four further real frames (174-177) while B stays held, before continuing to increment normally (178: 2.0, 179: 3.0) and converting to the Loop phase at 180 -- a genuine scripted animation-rate freeze (matching the already-modeled RunBrake run_brake_marker_frame/run_brake_freeze_speed pattern, a different mechanism from the entry-advance class this whole batch has otherwise been fixing), not a simple offset. ftFx_SpecialLw_Enter/SetVars sets fp->cmd_vars[1] = 4 (matching the observed four-frame freeze), a plausible but unconfirmed script marker value, not yet exported as pack data or independently verified. Reported per this loop's own stop condition (unmodeled system needing design/pack-data verification) rather than guessed at.
